author: Ibrahem96
quote:
I don't believe GTA 6 was properly optimized during development. There are far too many performance issues, especially in crowded areas. I've played for more than 15 hours, and I'm still not enjoying the game. It feels like we were misled by the promotional trailers.

Rockstar needs to address these issues in its future games because players always deserve better. Having a game run at only 30 FPS is a catastrophic mistake that is simply unforgivable.
